svg.title: Where Top-K sits in an MoE layer
svg.desc: A schematic with six experts and k=2. A token vector goes to a learned router. Our CPU operation selects indices 1 and 2 from its scores. The caller dispatches the token to those experts and combines their outputs.

g.aria-label: Where Top-K sits in an MoE layer
Router computes scores for all candidates.
Library returns IDs; the caller runs experts and combines outputs.
